rows: Place the Test plug type RTXH in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64R
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to one side of the Switch
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (17, 18) on Test plug RTXH18
Connect one terminal of the variable resistor via the Switch to point (3) on terminal block B50:X22
Connect the other terminal of the resistor to point (1) on terminal block B50:X22
Set the resistance value to 1 kΩ using the Fluke
Switch the Switch to the ON position, taking care to connect the Switch quickly as this affects the time value
Set the resistance value to 5 kΩ using the Fluke
Switch the Switch to the ON position, taking care to connect the Switch quickly as this affects the time value
Remove the wire terminals connected to points (1,3) on terminal block B50:X22
Remove the Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64R
Reset all the signals on the relay (64R)

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the earth-fault protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 19 October 2002.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service
Open a work order
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Variable resistor, 25 kΩ
True RMS Multimeter type Fluke 78
Milisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS-5N
Test leads
Test leads
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Switch (2 Pole)
Variable resistor, 25 kΩ
True RMS Multimeter type Fluke 78
Milisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS-5N
Test leads
Test leads
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Switch (2 Pole)
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Place the Test plug type RTXH in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64R | 1
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to one side of the Switch | 2
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (17, 18) on Test plug RTXH18 | 3
Connect one terminal of the variable resistor via the Switch to point (3) on terminal block B50:X22 | 4
Connect the other terminal of the resistor to point (1) on terminal block B50:X22 | 5
Set the resistance value to 1 kΩ using the Fluke | 6
Reset the timer | 7
Switch the Switch to the ON position, taking care to connect the Switch quickly as this affects the time value | 8
Record the time value | 9
Set the resistance value to 5 kΩ using the Fluke | 10
Reset the timer | 11
Switch the Switch to the ON position, taking care to connect the Switch quickly as this affects the time value | 12
Record the time value | 13
Remove the wire terminals connected to points (1,3) on terminal block B50:X22 | 14
Remove the Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x64R | 15
Reset all the signals on the relay (64R) | 16
